agent_explanation: Single ball in free fall hits arena floor between steps 55 and 56. With e=1 the bounce should at most reverse velocity, but speed grows 12.36->14.20 and energy 83.86->108.99 with no controller work. Likely cause: floor contact resolution adds positional correction (push-out) on a deeply penetrated fast body combined with impulse reflection plus gravity integrated in 8 substeps, net injecting energy instead of conserving it.
